picks.matchup: Green Bay Packers at Los Angeles Rams
picks.analysis: Matthew Stafford and the Rams host Green Bay on Thanksgiving Eve. The key matchup is protection against the Packers pass rush: Stafford needs clean pockets to attack intermediate windows, while Green Bay can disrupt that rhythm with pressure. At -2, Los Angeles covers with a field-goal win; -3 would turn that same result into a push. The home setting and favorable spread are the appeal, but offensive-line availability is crucial.
